sql:
SELECT
              t1.title,
              t1.url
            FROM
              fct_posting AS t1
            INNER JOIN
              dim_company AS t2
            ON
              t1.company_key = t2.company_key
            WHERE
              t2.platform = 'Reddit'
              AND t1.family = 'AI'
              AND t1.remote_us = TRUE
              AND t1.is_open = TRUE
